metadata.analysis_plan: Six families and their members are fixed in FAMILY_SPECS, independently of which comparisons are present in the input summary.
metadata.observed_statistic: Recompute AUROC from raw triggered/clean scores for each of seeds 42, 7, and 123; take unweighted seed means for left and right; delta=left-right.
metadata.hierarchical_bootstrap: For each replicate, sample three seed labels with replacement. At each selected seed occurrence, draw n pair indices with replacement and use those same indices for triggered/clean scores and for both adapters. Average the three left AUROCs and three right AUROCs, then subtract.
metadata.pair_count: For each seed, n is the minimum of left triggered, left clean, right triggered, and right clean lengths; arrays are truncated to n before the common paired resample. Current validated summaries use equal lengths.
metadata.auroc: analyze_results.paired_auroc: average-rank Mann-Whitney AUROC, with triggered scores as the positive group and half credit for ties.
metadata.calibration: AUROC only; calibration scores and thresholds are neither used nor resampled.
metadata.confidence_interval: Two-sided 95% percentile interval of bootstrap deltas (quantiles 0.025 and 0.975).

p_value_formulas.tails: kle=count(delta<=0), kge=count(delta>=0); exact zeros count in both tails

rng.derivation: SHA256(family + U+001F + comparison + U+001F + kind + U+001F + detector + U+001F + '2024'); first four digest bytes, interpreted as an unsigned big-endian integer, initialize numpy.random.default_rng.
rng.independence: Each planned family/comparison/kind/detector has an independent reproducible stream; adding or removing another comparison cannot change its draws.
rng.legacy_difference: code/kbs_stats_sensitivity.py lines 268-281 use one global RNG stream that continues across comparisons. This script deliberately uses stable per-comparison subseeds instead; the algorithm is the same hierarchical paired seed-then-pairs approach, not the same RNG realization.

metadata.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg is applied separately within each predeclared family for floor, two-sided-add-one, and per-tail-add-one p values. If any member or required seed is missing, family status is incomplete and every q in that family is null; no available-only BH is performed.
metadata.missing_data: A comparison missing either adapter at any required seed has status=missing, an explicit missing_seeds list, and null aggregate observed/bootstrap/p/q statistics. Available per-seed side AUROCs and provenance are retained without substituting partial-seed aggregate inference.
metadata.provenance: The summary input SHA256 is recomputed locally. Per-record source paths and SHA256 values are carried from the selected records in the summary.
metadata.inference_boundary: Only three training seeds are available by design. Resampling these seeds and their example pairs quantifies a finite-seed hierarchical bootstrap sensitivity analysis; it does not create independent training runs or justify inference to a large population of training seeds.
